Go to operation -> Search view, search any reservation and click the edit button.
The edit booking page should open successfully.
Go to current view, make a new reservation. Then click the mark arrival button.
The mark arrival dialog should open successfully. Click confirm to mark arrival (No need to call POS Interface).
The reservation should be arrivied and the seat color should be chnaged. Click the arrival icon again.
The change arrival cover dialog should open successfully.
Change the arrival cover and click confirm.
If success, the arrival cover should change.
Go to memo view, check the memo in each period should show normally.
Go to bulk block table page. Check the outlet and period type option work normally.

# CUS0261 - LPS SVC Issue Card Report

## Report Information
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | LPS SVC Issue Card Report |
| Code | CUS0261 |

## Parameters to Validate
| Parameters Name | Description | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Date Type | Select the business day scope of the report data. (single-select). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit | Current Business Day, Last Business Day, Last Month, Specified As Below | Current Business Day |
| Shops | Select shops to display. (multi-select). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Outlets | Select outlets to display. (multi-select) | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Revenue/Non-Revenue | Select the revenue scope of check data. (single-select) | All, Revenue, Non-Revenue, Advance Order | - |

## Data Fields to Validate
| Fields Name | Fields Description | Field Calculation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Report Title | Show corresponding report title by selection [Shops / Outlets]: show report name; if select a single shop show shop name, else no show; if select a single outlet show outlet name, else no show | - |
| Selected Outlets | Show outlet name, originate from Outlets parameter | - |
| Business Day | Show date range, originate from Date Type parameter | - |
| Outlet | Show specified outlet name, breakdown by this | - |
| Business Day (Per Breakdown) | Show specified date, breakdown by this | - |
| Card No. | Show account SVC card number | - |
| Issue Card Amt. | Show payment values amount for issue card. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Time | Show item order local time (YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock | - |
| Payment Type | Show check payment method name (will only show one payment method name). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Payment Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit | - |
| Employee No. | Show employee number from issue card | - |
| Card Type | Show SVC card type (QA result: Block) | - |
| Card Level | Show SVC card level (QA result: Block) | - |
| Total Amount | Count the total amount of add on the business day. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Sum of Issue Card Amt. per business day |
| No. Of Record | Show number of issue card times | Count of records |
| ** END OF REPORT ** | End-of-report marker | - |

| Fix Version | JIRA Ticket |
